turns.sentence: Yes, I heard it might snow tonight.
Really? I should bring a warmer coat.
I hope the roads aren't too icy tomorrow.
Do you think the weather will hold up for the picnic on Saturday?
The forecast says sunny in the morning, but there's a chance of rain later in the afternoon.
Maybe we should move it earlier, just to be safe.
Good idea — let's start around eleven instead of one.
I'll let the others know about the change.
I still haven't quite adjusted to how quickly the weather here can turn from sunny to pouring rain.
Yeah, it catches most newcomers off guard — the golden rule here is to always carry an umbrella, rain or shine.
I'll admit I've been caught out more than once without one.
You'll get the hang of it eventually — after a year or so, checking the sky becomes second nature.
I'll hold you to that — for now, I'm just going to keep an umbrella in every bag I own.
